visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five women are standing in a long, brightly lit corridor. They are dressed in athletic cheerleader uniforms with white shorts and crop tops in red, white, and blue patterns. They are initially in a fixed V-formation posing for the camera. (2) The camera performs a rapid dolly-in motion, focusing tightly on the central woman who has long dark hair and bright red lipstick. She maintains direct eye contact with the lens as she begins to move. (3) The entire group begins a synchronized dance routine. They move their arms in circular motions and step side-to-side rhythmically. The background remains a consistent hallway with purple and green doors. (4) The women lean their torsos forward and perform a coordinated, exaggerated head-shaking motion. Their hair swings violently to the rhythm as they maintain their formation in the narrow space. (5) The group returns to an upright position, continuing the energetic choreography with overhead arm waves and pointing gestures towards the camera. One woman in the background is seen walking past a doorway briefly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a casual male voice speaking in Mandarin with a low pitch and moderate speed. The background is nearly silent, suggesting a controlled indoor environment. (2) A sharp synthesized whoosh sound effect creates a transition. The male voice cuts out abruptly as high-energy electronic dance music starts with a prominent 4-on-the-floor kick drum. (3) The BGM features repeated male vocal samples saying 'So sexy' in a rhythmic pattern. The music is characterized by heavy bass and bright synthesizer stabs with a very strong beat. (4) The audio texture shifts as the vocal samples change to a repetitive rhythmic chant 'A-yo, a-yo' that synchronizes with a heavy percussive impact on every second beat. (5) The track transitions into a melodic loop with female vocal samples singing 'Waggle waggle' and 'Hey-oh'. The intensity remains high with continuous electronic drums and bright spectral weight until the file ends.
